index_title: Unfiltered phase labels, synchronized terminal orders and same-host tuple expansion property
scope: Private B064: all EIGHT unfiltered-EP source results, THREE auxiliary equations, sixteen definitions, 112 human claims and fourteen tasks. An independent finite-template singleton Ramsey criterion gives unary EP exactly for core type tables. Actual terminal symmetry gives unique coordinate values, trivial return holonomy and one complete pointed reset-edge type. The genuine PURE-IMAGINARY hidden SAP source supplies ordered fresh midpoints over the entire actual closed pair base; one fixed full Ramsey provider and legal reversal prove each relative task EP. Orders add no functions, so precise finite-chain EP composition applies. All actual MI tuple coverage, distributivity/cofinality, canonical fine supports and SAME-HOST lifting hypotheses are discharged before visible EP. The genuine unfiltered table is core, so the explicit final AP+HOM-CCO expansion has Ramsey and EP without deleting labels. The finite-original case is separately completed using actual unique terminal tags and zero-coordinate roots. No new external theorem, source TeX edit, EPPA or Lean certification.
scope_explanation: Each statement retains its independent generic or actual terminal context. EP always means forall expanded target exists ONE fixed reduct host forall allowed competing expansions an induced embedding. Actual hidden structures are finite induced unary-closed members, possibly orphan-only. Generic singleton shapes are actual one-point objects; label names are not individually named in the finite template. All functions/domains are retained through the relational/order tower.

assumptions.name: Independent finite pair-local template setting
assumptions.statement: K is a hereditary finite complete atomic binary age with retained original sorts. U_T is a reasonable reduct-surjective finite unary expansion defined exactly by its realized original-atom/type-pair tables R_a, with EVERY listed pair realized on distinct actual vertices, including repeated labels. T consists of realized complete labels. R is a hereditary reasonable reduct-surjective Ramsey expansion of U_T with JEP and exactly ONE actual expanded one-point shape per label: every vertex induces that shape, so its singleton embeddings are legitimate. Template endomorphisms preserve original sorts and every R_a; the individual new labels are NOT constants or unary predicates of the TEMPLATE.

assumptions.name: Independent symmetric equivariant-coordinate setting
assumptions.statement: G acts transitively on S and every G-invariant binary relation on S is symmetric. The two displayed maps tau,sigma:S->B are equivariant surjections onto the SAME transitive G-set B. No CCO, Ramsey, SAP, finiteness or terminality is assumed for the kernel/involution part.

assumptions.name: Conditional terminality for coordinate uniqueness only
assumptions.statement: Only for the final uniqueness implication in the preceding generic setting, there is NO invariant equivalence strictly above the common kernel whose relative index over that kernel is finite and greater than one. A finite strict interval is excluded, not merely a represented sublattice or a no-index-two condition on unnamed objects.

assumptions.name: Bound actual terminal clone and pure-imaginary instance
assumptions.statement: Mdagger=Qdagger x N is an actual finite-sorted FULL triangle-defined homogeneous symmetric binary SAP+HOM-CCO terminal clone source. Every strict cover in EVERY FULL current invariant-equivalence lattice has infinite relative index, including Top covers. Owner sorts are infinite in this parameterized branch. The actual hidden signature has proper nonidentity represented MI quotient sorts, all complete actual mixed semantic cylinders and equivariant unary projections/upward maps/quotient transitions with inverses. Named functions are total on their prescribed input sorts and undefined off-sort; no proper quotient map returns to a real sort. Choose finite meet-representing MI charts for each K_s. Order assertions use fixed hidden SORT priority and transition-synchronized within-cut fibre orders with parent-coordinate lex reconstruction; existence of their legal Ramsey class is proved, not assumed as an EP input. This is a BOUND intermediate instance, discharged from A06 for the main infinite theorem.

assumptions.name: Independent abstract same-host tuple-EP parameters
assumptions.statement: For the abstract implication only, H^o->H is a reasonable reduct-surjective precompact unary-functional/relational expansion with EP and a full finite tuple code. The four stated contracts hold: canonical unexpanded generated supports; cofinal finite E with h(N(E))=E; EVERY allowed full visible expansion lifts to that SAME E; and the natural ALL-embeddings correspondence with original fine-colour recovery. These are parameters of the abstract theorem, discharged concretely in C73-C84 rather than assumed for the final application.

assumptions.name: Original infinite one-sort AP source
assumptions.statement: Q is countably infinite, transitive and homogeneous in a finite complete symmetric binary language of actual pair orbitals, with ordinary age AP and semantic HOM CCO. No old SAP, terminality, finite-packet MI assumption, Ramsey expansion or expansion property is an input. The actual genuine maximal-character safe terminalisation, not arbitrary unary labels, is the recipe used in the main construction.

assumptions.name: Separate finite original source
assumptions.statement: For the finite-original case, Q is a nonempty FINITE transitive homogeneous complete symmetric binary AP+HOM-CCO source. Apply the same actual infinite-clone cover and genuine finite maximal-character terminalisation; the owner quotient remains this finite Q. This case does not satisfy A06 or the infinite-owner A04 parameter and is proved separately.

assumptions.statement: For the ancillary minimum-rank core-filter remark, the provider is relational (or otherwise its retained-label induced restrictions are actual closed substructures). This is the explicitly relational fallback in the source, not an extra premise of the genuine unfiltered construction.

definitions.name: EP quantifier
definitions.statement: For every expanded target Astar choose ONE unexpanded host B before receiving ANY competing allowed Bstar; then an induced Astar embedding must exist for EVERY Bstar.

definitions.statement: A Jplus fibre on the J quotient is identified by the tuple of ALL strict-coarser represented MI coordinate values. Empty key means Jplus=Top.

definitions.statement: P=cl{u,v} is the FULL actual induced unary closure of the specified hidden pair, not an arbitrary pair of the same coarse parent.

definitions.statement: N(D) contains ALL valid tagged selected-MI tuples; h(A) is the marked induced unary closure of their coordinate terms, with no additional tuple quotient.

definitions.statement: m is ONE complete quotient semantic cylinder, possibly containing many old fine atoms; its strong product is a diversity palette and its RAW product separately includes equality.

claims.name: A finite bijective endomorphism is an automorphism
claims.statement: A bijective finite-template endomorphism maps each finite R_a injectively into itself, hence onto it; the same holds for original-sort predicates. Its inverse preserves them all. Thus End=Aut is equivalent to every endomorphism being surjective.

claims.name: A nonsurjective endomorphism omits a realized label
claims.statement: If an endomorphism is not an automorphism, C01 makes it nonsurjective and some realized t is absent from its image.

claims.name: Postcomposition preserves every legal old marking
claims.statement: For ANY old finite host B and ANY legal marking lambda, f composed lambda is legal because f preserves every original R_a and sort predicate in the exact pair-local rule.

claims.name: The omitted singleton contradicts EP on every host
claims.statement: Every old B has at least one legal marking by reduct-surjectivity. Its postcomposition C03 omits t and contains no expanded t-singleton. Thus no fixed old B can witness EP for that singleton.

claims.name: Inverse-relabelled targets are all legal
claims.statement: If every table endomorphism is an automorphism, for each alpha in Aut(T), the finite inverse-relabelled alpha^-1 Astar is legal on the SAME old target by the exact pair-local rule.

claims.name: Store all labels and EVERY allowed pair
claims.statement: Choose provider expansions of every C05 target, each realized singleton and EVERY allowed actual atom/type pair, including two DISTINCT real vertices carrying the same label. There are finitely many witnesses.

claims.name: One full provider object contains all witnesses
claims.statement: Finite repeated JEP in R embeds the finite collection C06 into one D. Disjoint witness images are not required.

claims.name: Simultaneous singleton homogenization uses only Ramsey arrows
claims.statement: If T is empty the old/unary age has only the empty carrier and EP is immediate. Otherwise enumerate actual singleton shapes and choose |T|-colour Ramsey arrows in reverse peeling order; iteratively restrict to ONE D copy on which every singleton colouring is separately constant. No EP or joint language action is used.

claims.name: The old witness precedes the arbitrary competitor
claims.statement: Let B be the original reduct of the C08 Ramsey host. Only AFTER fixing it receive any competing legal T-marking lambda prime of B, and colour each reference singleton at x by lambda prime(x).

claims.name: The homogeneous copy induces one map on ALL labels
claims.statement: On the selected D copy, the competitor label is a fixed f(t) on every reference label t. Every t occurs in D, so this defines f on all of T, respecting original sorts.

claims.name: Stored pair witnesses force a template endomorphism
claims.statement: For each (s,t) in R_a, its actual pair witness in D has competitor labels f(s),f(t); competitor legality gives (f(s),f(t) in R_a. This includes same-reference-label pairs on distinct vertices. Hence f is a template endomorphism.

claims.name: The stored inverse relabelling recovers the exact target
claims.statement: The core hypothesis and C11 give f=alpha in Aut(T). The stored alpha^-1 Astar copy therefore has competitor labels alpha(alpha^-1(t))=t and exactly the prescribed old fine colours. It embeds Astar into this arbitrary competitor.

claims.name: Finite simultaneous-singleton core criterion
claims.statement: If T is empty both the old/unary age have only empty carriers and EP/core are immediate. Otherwise C04 proves the only-if implication and C09-C12 the converse, with ONE old B for EVERY competitor. Thus EP(U_T/K) iff End(T)=Aut(T) under independent A01.

claims.name: The coordinate comparison is symmetric
claims.statement: The relation R(x,y):tau(x)=sigma(y) is G-invariant, hence symmetric by A02.

claims.name: The two coordinate kernels agree
claims.statement: If sigma(x)=sigma(y), choose z with tau(z)=sigma(x). Symmetry of R(z,x),R(z,y) gives tau(x)=sigma(z)=tau(y). Interchanging tau and sigma gives the reverse kernel inclusion.

claims.name: One equivariant quotient bijection relates the maps
claims.statement: Define f(tau(x))=sigma(x). Kernel equality gives well-definedness and injectivity, surjectivity follows from sigma, and equivariance follows by evaluation. Thus sigma=f composed tau.

claims.name: The quotient bijection is an involution
claims.statement: Symmetry of tau(x)=f(tau(y)) implies the reversed equality, so f squared is identity on the onto tau image.

claims.name: A nontrivial equivariant involution creates a finite interval
claims.statement: An equivariant involution on transitive B either fixes every point or has two-point orbits everywhere. In the latter case its orbit equivalence pulls back to an invariant equivalence strictly above ker(tau) of relative index two.

claims.name: Terminality forces literal coordinate uniqueness
claims.statement: A03 excludes the interval C18, so f=Id and sigma=tau on the ACTUAL source. This is equality of functions, not merely equality of their kernels.

claims.name: Symmetric coordinate source export
claims.statement: C15-C17 prove equal kernels and an equivariant involution; C19 proves its conditional terminal triviality, exactly the stated generic coordinate lemma.

claims.statement: All term equalities, actual unary/fine-cylinder data and incidences of one owner root are equivariant. Current owner transitivity makes these unary predicates constant on its FULL realized terminal label, including MR tuple roots.

claims.statement: Pull an invariant binary relation on B_J back along the real projection. Its truth is a union of finitely many actual old real pair orbitals. Therefore there are finitely many such quotient relations, and each equivariant permutation graph is one actual orbital.

claims.name: Every equivariant quotient permutation has finite order
